summary: Phases 1-6 of 8 complete and committed. Phase 7 (Deliverables 3+4, cap removal/dedup): the ancestorTimes undirected-traversal bug that previously blocked the dedup gate past depth 1 is now FIXED and committed (8b3e8df7 for Cslib/Logics/Temporal/Tableau/Branch.lean, 89a748d7 for the identical duplicate in Cslib/Logics/Bimodal/Metalogic/Decidability/SignedFormula.lean, per explicit user authorization). Re-verification confirmed Gp -> F^k p now flips CLOSED for all k = 1..5 (previously stalled at k = 1), with 0 regressions across all 30 previously-green rows and the K-row/G-F-duality row remaining CLOSED. guard_msgs reconciled in CslibTests/TableauConformance.lean (8d1689f7) for all 12 rows that flip, per the pre-existing rule that expected values are justified by mathematical validity, never by implementation output. Whole-project lake build (3253/3253) and lake test (9247/9247) both green; Cslib/ bare-sorry count unchanged at 5; 0 new axioms. The Bimodal fix's only proof-relevant consumer (Saturation.lean:669's expandBranchWithFuel_sound, a by_cases over an opaque Bool) needed no proof changes; the full Decidability barrel (792 jobs) builds green. HOWEVER: while re-verifying, a NEW, distinct blocker was discovered -- Hp -> HHp (past transitivity), one of Phase 7's own six D3 verification rows, remains OPEN. Root cause: Rules.lean's allPastPosAt reuses the future-only TimeOrdering.ancestorTimes to decide T(Hphi) propagation, checking whether t is in t_anc's forward light-cone instead of whether t_anc is in t's forward light-cone (the direction actually needed to propagate a past obligation backward) -- an asymmetry bug unrelated to the Branch.lean/SignedFormula.lean bug just fixed, and in a file (Rules.lean) outside this dispatch's authorized scope (Branch.lean/SignedFormula.lean only). Documented in the plan's Phase 7 section (BLOCKER 2) and inline in the test file; not fixed. Phase 7 heading kept [BLOCKED] because one of its own stated verification rows is unresolved. Phase 8 remains blocked on Phase 7 per the plan's dependency table.

blockers.description: IBranchSaturation's sat_timp field (and truthLemma's pre-existing T-imp sorry) cannot be discharged without a new step-lt-style fuel-sufficiency measure for applyPersistenceFixpoint's own recursion (Scheme.lean, 'sat_timp discharge STOP-gate' comment block, updated in place). Phase 2's branching-rule redesign resolved the determinacy half (Gap 2); the fuel half (Gap 1) is untouched, pre-existing, and scoped as a full-phase-sized undertaking on its own. Carried forward unchanged.

RESOLVED this dispatch (commits 8b3e8df7, 89a748d7): Branch.lean's ancestorTimes (and its identical Bimodal duplicate in SignedFormula.lean) collected both directPredecessors and directSuccessors at every recursion step, treating the time-ordering constraint graph as undirected, so once any time-creation edge existed, a time point ended up in its own ancestor list, making isTemporallyBlocked spuriously true and capping the Phase 7 dedup gate at depth 1. Fixed by dropping directSuccessors, keeping only directPredecessors, in both files. Re-verified: Gp -> F^k p flips CLOSED for k = 1..5 (previously stalled at k=1); 0 regressions across the 30 previously-green rows; Bimodal Decidability.Saturation's proof (expandBranchWithFuel_sound) is insensitive to the definitional change (opaque Bool case split via by_cases) and needed no edits; full Decidability barrel (792 jobs) and whole-project build (3253 jobs) both green. guard_msgs reconciled (8d1689f7).

NEW (discovered this dispatch while re-verifying the ancestorTimes fix above): Hp -> HHp (past transitivity) is mathematically valid (dual of the confirmed-CLOSED Gp -> GGp) and is explicitly listed in Phase 7's own D3 verification criteria, but the tableau still reports it OPEN. Root cause: Rules.lean:148-155's allPastPosAt (responsible for propagating T(Hphi)@t_anc obligations to other times) uses the condition 't == t_anc || (ord.ancestorTimes sf.label ancestorLookupFuel).contains t', where ord.ancestorTimes is TimeOrdering.ancestorTimes -- a future-only closure (based on futureOf), the same one allFuturePosAt correctly uses for propagating T(Gphi). Propagating a past obligation T(Hphi)@t_anc to a time t is sound only when t is in t_anc's PAST (t < t_anc); the actual condition instead checks whether t is in t_anc's FUTURE. This is a distinct asymmetry bug -- different function (TimeOrdering.ancestorTimes, not Branch.ancestorTimes), different file (Rules.lean, not Branch.lean/SignedFormula.lean) -- unrelated to and not fixed by this dispatch's authorized ancestorTimes fix. Fixing it needs a genuine past-direction transitive closure in allPastPosAt (walking pastOf transitively from t_anc, or equivalently checking t_anc is reachable from t via futureOf), which is outside this dispatch's authorized file scope (only Branch.lean and SignedFormula.lean were authorized). Raised per the plan-compliance escalation protocol rather than patched unilaterally. guard_msgs for this row is correctly left at 'OPEN' (matching actual, non-regressed output) with an inline comment documenting the finding.
